area: Keystone testbed: scene picking as a crosshair query

find.report_claim: picking is a Keystone module for asking 'what is under this ray' against visible world meshes, and was one of 21 modules the shooter had never imported
find.live_evidence: the game already casts sim rays for combat but had no scene-level answer for AI/soak reports; cycle 178 moved the viewmodel to an overlay-layer rig, giving picking a real exclusion case to prove
find.consumer_evidence: raycast_scene skips overlay and hidden nodes and hit_report returns a JSON-safe summary with deterministic tie-breaking

read: probe of the shipped arena: straight ahead hits cover-5 at 17.5 m, yaw 0.8 hits wall-e, pitch -0.4 hits floor, pitch 1.4 misses cleanly
killed: reusing the sim's combat ray: that answers about colliders and damage, not the rendered scene, and would couple a presentation report to gameplay
picking without ignoring the muzzle: the flash is a short-lived world node and must never be reported as the crosshair target
a stored per-frame report: the first implementation made the test gate take 547 s instead of ~150 s because raycast_scene recomputes world bounds for every visible mesh on every simulation frame
analyze.survivor: an on-demand crosshair_pick() query backed by raycast_scene + hit_report, with the muzzle ignored and overlay nodes excluded by the module

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py imports Ray/hit_report/raycast_scene and exposes crosshair_pick() returning a JSON-safe scene hit from the sim eye along the sim aim; tests/test_keystone_picking_mechanics.py (5 tests) pins world hits, aim following, a clean sky miss, overlay exclusion and sim isolation; README testbed matrix and tree name the consumer and test
fix.performance_correction: the initial version cast the ray in _sync_scene and stored the report; the gate's test phase jumped from ~145 s to 547 s. It was converted to a query, after which the same gate took 97 s. The cycle-note and evidence record this so the per-frame form is not reintroduced

shooter.failing_first: 4 of 5 new tests failed with AttributeError before the consumer existed
shooter.mutation: replacing the raycast with hit_report(None) fails 3 of 5 tests; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 c9ce926a35eec59709d47bdca577f4e3c7614c93866d69e879a816cf08c42beb)
shooter.measured_hits: yaw 0 -> cover-5 @ 17.5 m; yaw 0.8 -> wall-e @ 27.18 m; pitch -0.4 -> floor @ 4.16 m; pitch 1.4 -> hit=False; overlay viewmodel never picked
shooter.gate_timing: per-frame report 547 s -> on-demand query 97 s for the test phase, 5/5 gates both times
